title: Cisco UCS C220 M5 Rack Server

items.h: Processor: Dual Intel Xeon Scalable Processor Support
Storage: SAS / SATA / NVMe options depending on configuration

tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The Cisco UCS C220 M5 Rack Server is a high-performance 1U enterprise rack server designed for data centers, virtualization, cloud computing, database applications, business-critical workloads, and general enterprise IT infrastructure. It combines powerful Intel Xeon Scalable processor support with high-speed DDR4 ECC memory, flexible storage options, PCIe expansion, and Cisco UCS management capabilities.


With its compact 1U rack-mount design, the Cisco UCS C220 M5 is an excellent solution for organizations that require reliable computing performance while optimizing valuable data center rack space. It is suitable for enterprise businesses, ISPs, cloud service providers, system integrators, and professional IT infrastructure deployments.


Key Features


  • Cisco UCS C220 M5 1U Rack Server
  • Supports dual Intel Xeon Scalable processors
  • DDR4 ECC memory support
  • High memory capacity for demanding workloads
  • Supports SAS, SATA, and NVMe storage configurations depending on chassis and backplane
  • Cisco RAID controller options
  • PCIe expansion slots for networking, storage, and accelerator cards
  • Cisco Integrated Management Controller for server management
  • High-speed Ethernet networking support
  • Compact 1U rack-mount form factor
  • Suitable for virtualization and cloud environments
  • Designed for enterprise applications and data center workloads
